title: Double Drip Cherry Ice Nic Salt 10ml E-Liquid
description: Double Drip Cherry Ice combines the bold, juicy flavour of ripe Cherry with a clean, cooling Menthol finish. The Cherry brings a rich, red-fruit sweetness with just a hint of tang, while the icy exhale adds freshness and balance to the overall profile. It’s a vibrant and satisfying vape that delivers a classic fruit-and-ice combination with clarity and depth. Formulated with nicotine salts for a smoother inhale and faster nicotine delivery, this e-liquid is blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio for optimum flavour and performance in MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices. It’s ideal for use with pod systems , refillable vapes , starter vape kits and other compact kits designed for lower-power vaping. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Double Drip Nic Salts are available in a wide range of bold and satisfying flavour profiles to suit everyday vaping. Double Drip are one of the most celebrated and influential e-liquid brands in the UK and the masterminds of some of the most iconic vape flavours ever made. Vibrant, authentic, and highly inventive flavours are a hallmark of all Double Drip vape juices, and this newest collection of truly timeless flavours in smooth, satisfying nic salts won’t disappoint.
